sessionBearer.description: Authorization: Bearer <session-id>.<session-secret>, issued by SESAME. HEIMDALL neither mints nor verifies it locally; it forwards it to the engine.

info.description:
The control-plane API. It is the contract the CLI, CI, and Terraform use; the Tachyon web tier is a thin proxy in front of it and adds no routes.

Every route except /healthz, /readyz, and /api/v1/version resolves to exactly one SESAME authorization action, listed as x-heimdall-action, evaluated once in middleware before any handler runs. A 403 carries SESAME's reason_code verbatim; a 503 means the engine did not answer and is never a bypass.

Generated from the route table by `heimdall contract`. Do not hand-edit.

post.description: Invoke the declared JSON function once using the stored application target and immutable published version. Input is transient. The API waits at most 45 seconds; a timeout does not cancel native execution and must not trigger automatic retry. A native handler error is returned in function_error with HTTP 200.

payload.description: Any JSON value, including null. Its UTF-8 JSON representation must not exceed 262144 bytes.

200.description: Native invocation response: version, request_id, payload, and optional function_error. A handler error does not imply transport failure.

400.description: Invalid payload, undeclared function, suspended application, or unsupported target routing.

504.description: The wait ended. Native execution may continue; do not retry automatically.
